extracted.name: Cream of Mushroom Cornbread with Sausage
extracted.description: A concoction that the grandkids want more and more of.
ingredient_lines: 1-1/3 cup condensed cream of Mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425° Fahrenheit. Gather the ingredients cornmeal, diced onion, flour, butter, seasonings, baking powder, and sugar. Knead together.
Add sausage, eggs, and knead well.
Add the milk, vinegar, and cream of Mushroom soup. Mix very well form like a batter. Pour into a nonstick pan. Bake 22-28 minutes or until the sides are pulled away from the pan.
Let rest 12 minutes and serve. I hope you enjoy!!
